summary: A candidate tells the chair they will sit out a vote on a check for their own campaign.
realLife: The Mojave Desert minutes record approval of a campaign contribution to Markovich and Markovich’s abstention on that motion (May 26, 2018).
inGame: needs: a proposed contribution, its recipient and the recorded vote.

turns.what: The member asks to be recorded as abstaining.
turns.pulledBy: The recipient abstains when the motion comes up.
turns.writesBack: The minutes distinguish the recipient from the members who approved payment.

turns.what: The chair records that the payment remains pending.
turns.writesBack: The treasurer has no approval to issue the check.
